title: Break-file release test must pin the stamp half: foreign stamp equals the holder's, so only the pid half is tested
description: Follow-up from the QCLI-495 narrow review (team-lead). In test/qcli495-id-allocation-unit.test.ts the not-my-file release test plants a break file whose stamp equals the breaker own stamp (now), so only the pid half of the release-only-if-own comparison is pinned. Use now+1 for the foreign stamp, and add a same-pid, different-stamp case. Not started.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The foreign break file in the release-only-if-own test carries a stamp different from the breaker stamp (now+1).
A same-pid, different-stamp case asserts the break file is left in place.
Mutating the release check to compare the pid only turns the new same-pid case red.

plan: 1. Reproduce the gap: the existing release-only-if-own test writes a foreign break file with a different pid but the SAME stamp, so only the pid half of the comparison is pinned.
2. Change that fixture foreign file to now+1 so it differs in both halves.
3. Add a same-pid, different-stamp case asserting the break file is left in place -- the only fixture that can distinguish pid+stamp release from pid-only.
4. Mutation control: make the release compare the pid alone and confirm the new same-pid case goes red while the rest stay green, then restore.
5. bun run check, commit on chore/QCLI-523-break-release-stamp, push, open the PR, report the head SHA.
implementationNotes: Round-1 verdict recorded on head d22a1093 (verdict file sha256 prefix b2cce5c0bdc5, deepseek unit, read-only): REQUEST_CHANGES. MAJOR: after the previous change the pid half of left.pid === mine.pid && left.at === mine.at was pinned by nothing, because the both-halves fixture now differs by stamp as well, so a release comparing the stamp alone left all 16 tests green -- the change rotated the gap instead of closing it. NIT 1: neither release test asserted that breakStaleLock returned true, so a false return after the seam but before unlink(lockPath) stayed green. NIT 2, a do-not-fix note: process.pid + 1 is deliberately not deadPid. FIX at 25c64171: a third case plants a foreign pid with the OWN stamp of the breaker and asserts the file is left in place; the two release cases now assert a true return; the both-halves fixture carries a comment recording why pid + 1 and not deadPid. MUTATION CONTROL, both ways, measured: pid-only mutant (stamp half dropped) gives 16 pass / 1 fail, the only red being the own-pid/different-stamp case; stamp-only mutant (pid half dropped) gives 16 pass / 1 fail, the only red being the new foreign-pid/own-stamp case; unmutated control 17 pass / 0 fail. Round 2 is a full review.

Round-2 FULL review recorded on head eba86889 (unit quest-cli-review-658r2, model deepseek-flash, DEC-183 Stage 1, read-only): APPROVE, PR merged to dev as 2b9c76a5 on 2026-10-22. The round-1 MAJOR is RESOLVED -- the foreign-pid/own-stamp case completes the boolean matrix and no mutant of the comparison at src/application/tasks/id-allocation.ts:278 survives (||, always, never, pid-only, stamp-only, ordering). Round-1 NIT 1 is fixed: all three release cases assert the break succeeded. CORRECTED COUNTS: the file at eba86889 holds 17 tests, not the 16 the earlier summary named, and 17/17 pass; the third case (foreign pid with the OWN stamp of the breaker) is one of them. The round-1 note counts (16 pass / 1 fail mutants, 17 pass / 0 fail control) refer to the post-fix file and remain correct as counts OF THAT FILE AT THAT TIME. One MINOR is pre-existing and outside this diff, filed as its own task rather than fixed here: the LOCKED-REREAD comparison at src/application/tasks/id-allocation.ts:263-269 has both halves individually unpinned, because the only interleaving test (:360-414) changes both halves at once.
finalSummary:
Delivered on chore/QCLI-523-break-release-stamp. The release-only-if-own test now plants a foreign break file differing in BOTH halves (pid+1 and stamp now+1), and a new case plants the breaker own pid with a different stamp (now+1) and asserts the break file is left in place. That new case is the only fixture in the suite that distinguishes pid+stamp release from pid-only release. Evidence: mutation control dropping the stamp half of the comparison in breakStaleLock turns exactly the new case red (1 of 16) while the other 15 stay green; restored, 16/16 pass and bun run check exits 0 on bun 1.4.2 (1267 tests, 0 fail).

 Correction, recorded 2026-10-22 after the round-2 full review (unit quest-cli-review-658r2, deepseek-flash, APPROVE at eba86889): the counts in this summary describe the pre-round-1 fix file. At the merged head test/qcli495-id-allocation-unit.test.ts holds 17 tests and 17 of 17 pass, and the new third case -- a foreign pid carrying the OWN stamp of the breaker -- is what pins the pid half. The round-1 both-halves fixture and its comment are unchanged.
